name: Build Signed AAB for Play Store on: push: branches: [ main ] workflow_dispatch: inputs: app_name: description: 'App Name (e.g., My App)' required: true default: 'My Web App' package_name: description: 'Package Name (e.g., com.example.myapp)' required: true default: 'com.example.mywebapp' app_url: description: 'Website URL (leave empty to use built‑in HTML)' required: false default: '' jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Checkout code uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Set up Node.js uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: '18' - name: Install Cordova run: npm install -g cordova - name: Set up JDK 17 uses: actions/setup-java@v4 with: distribution: 'temurin' java-version: '17' - name: Setup Android SDK uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3 - name: Create Cordova project run: | cordova create app "${{ github.event.inputs.package_name }}" "${{ github.event.inputs.app_name }}" cd app cordova platform add android - name: Prepare web content run: | cd app/www rm -rf * # اگر URL دیا گیا ہے تو اسے ترجیح دیں if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.app_url }}" ]; then echo "Downloading from URL: ${{ github.event.inputs.app_url }}" wget -r -np -nH --cut-dirs=1 -P . "${{ github.event.inputs.app_url }}" else # ورنہ ریپوزٹری میں موجود فائلوں کو استعمال کریں if [ -f "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/index.html" ]; then echo "Using project files from repository" cp -r "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"/* . else echo "No project files found. Using built-in HTML." # built-in HTML بغیر here-document کے (printf کا استعمال) printf '\n' > index.html printf '\n' >> index.html printf '\n' >> index.html printf ' \n' >> index.html printf ' \n' >> index.html printf ' %s\n' "${{ github.event.inputs.app_name }}" >> index.html printf ' \n' >> index.html printf '\n' >> index.html printf '\n' >> index.html printf '
\n' >> index.html printf '
\n' >> index.html printf '

📱 %s

\n' "${{ github.event.inputs.app_name }}" >> index.html printf '

پلے اسٹور کے لیے تیار

\n' >> index.html printf '
\n' >> index.html printf '
\n' >> index.html printf '

یہ ایک نمونہ UI ہے۔ آپ اسے YAML میں تبدیل کر سکتے ہیں۔

\n' >> index.html printf ' \n' >> index.html printf '
\n' >> index.html printf '
\n' >> index.html printf '\n' >> index.html printf '\n' >> index.html fi fi - name: Configure AndroidManifest for HTTP (if needed) run: | cd app/platforms/android/app/src/main sed -i '/| android:usesCleartextTraffic="true">|' AndroidManifest.xml - name: Build release AAB run: | cd app cordova build android --release -- --packageType=bundle - name: Set up signing keystore env: KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_BASE64 }} KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }} KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.KEY_ALIAS }} run: | if [ -n "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" ]; then echo "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 -d > keystore.jks else echo "No keystore secret found. Creating a debug keystore for testing (NOT for Play Store)." keytool -genkey -v -keystore debug.keystore -alias debug -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -storepass android -keypass android -dname "CN=Debug, OU=Debug, O=Debug, L=Debug, S=Debug, C=US" mv debug.keystore keystore.jks KEYSTORE_PASSWORD="android" KEY_ALIAS="debug" fi - name: Sign AAB run: | jarsigner -verbose -sigalg SHA1withRSA -digestalg SHA1 \ -keystore keystore.jks \ -storepass "$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" \ -keypass "$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" \ app/platforms/android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab \ "$KEY_ALIAS" - name: Verify signing run: | jarsigner -verify app/platforms/android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab echo "AAB signed successfully" - name: Upload AAB as artifact uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: app-release-aab path: app/platforms/android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab - name: (Optional) Also generate APK for testing run: | cd app cordova build android --release cp platforms/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../ - name: Upload APK artifact uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: app-release-apk path: app-release.apk
